static_traits.name: 江明
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends who support him, but finds it hard to open up to them; fears being judged, and relationship-building is affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone; expresses clearly, with fairly good logic; able to describe their own feelings and experiences; cooperates fairly well

basic_info.main_problem: 因独特外表（蓝橙色头发）常觉得被当作“怪人”，感到被误解与被评判；随着负面评论与注视增多，这种感受加重，并导致Social anxiety与Decreased self-confidence。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want to find ways to cope with these and get my confidence back.'
growth_experiences: High school时期开始玩滑板，经常遭遇他人的评判与标签（如被认为是“游手好闲”或“怪人”），由此形成被误解与被贴标签的体验，加深了对他人评价的敏感与not安。

A few years ago, after starting to dye their hair blue and orange, they frequently encountered strangers' gazes and negative comments in public places; this experience continuously strengthens the feeling of 'being judged / misunderstood', stronger recently.

core_beliefs: 我与众not同就会被视为怪人、not被接纳
I am easily labeled and misunderstood by others

special_situations.event: Being stared at by strangers in public or receiving negative comments about one's appearance (hair color)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人盯着我看或评论我的外表，就说明他们认为我是怪人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces going out or changes clothing/hairstyle to fit in and reduce the possibility of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们在看not起我；我就是个怪人

special_situations.event: Meeting newly acquainted people for the first time or attending unfamiliar social occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I interact with new people, they will label me an 'idler/weirdo' and reject me
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们肯定会评判我，not会接纳我

special_situations.event: Recalls and receives feedback about appearance (both praise and disparagement)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出现负面评论，就说明Overall evaluation都是负面的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视或negate赞美，只关注负面反馈以“准备”应对评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家大多not喜欢我这样的外表

special_situations.event: 被trigger对High school时期因滑板被贴标签的记忆
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being labeled in the past means it will always be so now
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 给自己贴“怪人”的标签以先发制人，或通过投入滑板来暂时逃离他人评判与Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一向被视为怪人，这永远not会改变

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and accepted, appreciated as one's unique self
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与改变外表来降低被评判的可能
Preemptively strikes with self-devaluation and self-labeling to reduce the risk of being hurt
Only expresses oneself in 'safe situations' such as skateboarding to maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A misunderstood outsider, a 'weirdo' prone to being judged

manifestations: Expresses a unique self through dyed hair and skateboarding
在公共场合因他人评价而动摇Freedom表达，内心产生冲突
Afraid of being judged; hard to build meaningful connections with others
Has supportive friends but finds it hard to open up about feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats others' evaluations of 'weirdo / idler' as fact
Trying to change one's style to fit the so-called 'normal' in order to gain acceptance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在公共场合过度自我审视，反复怀疑“我是not是有问题”
In socializing, is careful and tense; hard to express oneself naturally

exception_events.target_problem: 在公共场合或Interacting with newly met people时，来访者通常会感到被评判并产生Social anxiety，从而回避接触。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 当滑板运动时，来访者感到Freedom与掌控，能专注当下、较少在意他人看法，体验到自信与积极情绪。
exception_events.reason: not同情境与做法：滑板提供高专注与掌控感，注意力Turning against the selfskill与体验；以自我价值与内在感受为参照而非外部评价，因而Anxiety显著降低。

positive_force: The sense of control and self-efficacy brought by skateboarding can evoke confidence and positive emotions
Able to notice and willing to try focusing on positive feedback (someone praised the hair color)
Proactively seeks help and is willing to try new methods (reality testing, challenging assumptions)
negative_force: Excessively focuses on others' evaluations and external recognition
认知扭曲（读心、过度概括、心理过滤）加剧Self-doubt
Long-term experience of being labeled leads to sensitivity and fear of being judged

target_behavior.behavior: 在公共场合和与新朋友互动时的Social avoidance与Anxiety
antecedent: Being stared at or having one's appearance commented on by strangers
target_behavior.core_reason: 过往被贴标签的经历与对他人评价的读心/过度概括等认知偏差，内化为“与众not同就会被视为怪人”的负性核心信念
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与羞耻感，降低即时Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 难以建立有意义的关系；Impaired self-esteem；社交与自我照料受影响

target_behavior.behavior: Changes appearance to cater to others (suppressing self-expression)
antecedent: Anticipation会被评判或听到负面评论
Preparing to attend social or public occasions
target_behavior.core_reason: Tries to gain external recognition through pleasing, reducing the risk of being labeled
target_behavior.function: Gains others' acceptance / reduces negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in self-consistency；短期Anxiety可能减轻但长期自我价值受损
